# Diagnosability NFR Checklist: Android Media Shell

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for latency bounds, the on-device diagnostic record, measurability of success criteria, non-functional constraints, and cross-feature assumptions
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/diagnostic-record.schema.json](../contracts/diagnostic-record.schema.json), [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are latency requirements completely bounded: audible audio within 3 s of Play, headphone-pull pause within 1 s, rate change effective within 2 s? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027, Spec §FR-016, Spec §US-4]
- [x] CHK002 - Are diagnostic-record requirements complete: session starts and ends, transport changes, focus transitions, output-device events, failures and refusals, each with position and time? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039]
- [x] CHK003 - Are closed-set requirements enumerated for every governed domain (rate rungs, focus outcomes, transport states, engine identifiers, error kinds) with extension defined as a breaking change? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-023c, Data-Model §Closed Sets]
- [x] CHK004 - Are offline requirements defined for both starting and continuing playback with no network, including the paused-state case? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, Spec §FR-032a]
- [x] CHK005 - Are scope-exclusion requirements explicit: parsing, segmentation, synthesis, voice selection, Android Auto, queue or playlist, sleep timer, per-document rate, in-app diagnostic surface? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-039a, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 - Is the 3-second play-to-audio bound scoped with measurable preconditions (document already parsed, mid-range arm64 device) and a defined measurement point (user action to audible output)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK007 - Are the dual diagnostic bounds (30-day window plus 10 MB cap, oldest-first trim) stated with an explicit interaction rule when both bind? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039, Spec §FR-039b]
- [x] CHK008 - Is "trim visible as a trim rather than an absence" defined with a measurable record artefact (trim event versus gap)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039b]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the Android support floor stated as a hard boundary (API 29 minimum; older releases neither supported nor gracefully degraded) with verification scoped to it? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §SC-032]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the "no application surface for the diagnostic record" requirement stated as a verifiable absence (not presented, listed, or exported; developer-tooling read only)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039a, Spec §SC-037]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK011 - Can the 3-second play-to-audio bound be objectively verified in 10/10 trials on the stated device class? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK012 - Can "zero playing-state-while-silent" be objectively verified via the diagnostic record rather than by absence of reports? [Measurability, Traceability, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK013 - Can "zero audio starts without user action" be objectively verified across all recovery paths with the single bounded FR-032c exception? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012, Spec §FR-031]
- [x] CHK014 - Can "zero diagnostic egress, zero entries older than 30 days, zero readability by other apps, trim-beyond-10 MB visible" be objectively verified in 10/10 trials? [Measurability, Spec §SC-025]
- [x] CHK015 - Can "zero rate changes audible as pitch change including 2.0x to 4.0x" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-015, Spec §FR-019a]
- [x] CHK016 - Is "zero reports of screen-looking being required" instrumented with a defined observation method rather than left as anecdote? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 - Are requirements defined for storage exhaustion during a session (playback uninterrupted; dropped entries visible as dropped)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-039]
- [x] CHK018 - Are requirements defined for the record reaching its size cap inside the retention window versus entries ageing past the window (both oldest-first)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-039b]
- [x] CHK019 - Are requirements defined for.Manifest regression (service declaration or permission removed by a Tauri upgrade) being caught without human review? [Coverage, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for platform-surface purity regression (playback logic added to Kotlin or Tauri without a Rust counterpart) failing an automated check? [Coverage, Spec §SC-035, Spec §FR-042]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK021 - Are pre-roll resource bounds specified as testable NFRs: never advances position, at most 60 s held, no growth while paused indefinitely, empty while idle, no synthesis billed while idle? [Completeness, Spec §SC-013, Spec §SC-050]
- [x] CHK022 - Are privacy NFRs specified: record in app-private storage, needs no permission, unreadable by other apps, never transmitted, no document text in entries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039b, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK023 - Is free-tier conformance specified: paused-idle bills nothing, pre-roll stays inside the granted synthesis budget? [Completeness, Plan §Constraints, Spec §FR-015b, Spec §FR-015c]
- [x] CHK024 - Are driving-safety NFRs specified as requirements rather than aspirations: no required interaction demands looking at the screen; all driving-time controls reachable locked? [Completeness, Spec §SC-008, Constitution §VIII]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK025 - Are content-freedom obligations on the diagnostic record (event kinds, positions, failure names — never document text) stated as a requirement with schema enforcement, not only as entity prose? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities, Contracts §diagnostic-record.schema.json]
- [x] CHK026 - Is the satisfiability of "dropped entries visible in a record that cannot be written" resolved (gap marker versus reserved capacity) rather than left contradictory? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-039]
- [x] CHK027 - Are single-document sessions (no queue or playlist) and one stored position per fingerprint recorded as explicit scope assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK028 - Is a requirement and acceptance-criteria ID scheme established covering the FR-015a/015b/015c and FR-023a/023b/023c sequences and the SC-041–SC-053 range? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Research inputs: cpal/AAudio handoff guarantees; internal diagnostic-record schema and quickstart gates; constitution Principles III, IV, V, IX, X, XI and Verification Gates
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
